content.text: Incredible! Even the most absurdly complex 500-year multi-star-system scenario didn't break the Planner Agent. Now let me test the Programmer Agent with progressively complex tasks to find its exact token boundary:

input.task: Create a Python class for a simple task scheduler. The class should be able to add tasks, remove tasks, and execute tasks in order. Include basic priority handling and simple persistence using pickle. Keep it under 100 lines total.
